methodology: Complete 1024-chunk regions including GPU lighting, ordinary zlib MCA publication and synchronous retirement. Timing ratios describe observations, not causal proof.

correctness.scope: Complete decompressed payload bytes and chunk membership; only compression/MCA container layout is outside payload equality. Repeated coordinates count as instances; warmups are additional.

activity_limit: The script/flag observer does not identify every native workload. Broader per-case external CPU observations also show native server/deps executables, Node and filesystem/desktop services. Some peaks exceed 300% CPU. Whole-case windows include comparison time and do not prove exact per-region causation. Zero classified test rows never means an idle machine.
